mapper.sql: record_id, commission_no, user_id, user_type, order_id, order_no, order_amount, commission_type, commission_rate, commission_amount, commission_status, payout_time, settlement_period, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, deleted_at, version, tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT cr.record_id, cr.commission_no, cr.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, cr.user_type, CASE cr.user_type WHEN 1 THEN '采购员' WHEN 2 THEN '管理员' ELSE '未知' END AS user_type_name, cr.order_id, cr.order_no, cr.order_amount, cr.commission_type, CASE cr.commission_type WHEN 1 THEN '固定金额' WHEN 2 THEN '百分比' ELSE '未知' END AS commission_type_name, cr.commission_rate, cr.commission_amount, cr.commission_status, CASE cr.commission_status WHEN 0 THEN '待发放' WHEN 1 THEN '已发放' WHEN 2 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END AS commission_status_name, cr.payout_time, cr.settlement_period, cr.remark, cr.created_by, cr.created_at, cr.updated_by, cr.updated_at FROM commission_record cr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON cr.user_id = u.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cr.is_deleted = 0 AND cr.record_id = #{recordId}
SELECT FROM commission_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
